disease_profile.stage: Rai Stage II, diagnosed 2 years ago, started treatment 8 months ago
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Ibrutinib 420 mg once daily (BTK inhibitor). Ongoing therapy with quarterly check-ups.
key_symptoms: Frequent infections (2-3 sinus infections per year since diagnosis)
Swollen lymph nodes in the neck and armpits
Occasional bruising on arms and legs
disease_profile.trajectory: Responding well to treatment. Lymphocyte count has decreased significantly. Physician reports partial remission. Some side effects from ibrutinib (mild diarrhea, joint aches).

causes: Weakened immune system as she got older
Stress from losing her husband three years ago
